title: Dadpe Pohe
description: A no-cook Maharashtrian poha made by soaking thin flattened rice and tossing it with coconut, lemon and chilli, light and refreshing.
steps: Rinse the thin poha briefly in a colander so it softens, then drain and leave it for 5 minutes.
Add the grated coconut, green chilli, tomato, coriander leaves, lemon juice, sugar and salt and toss lightly.
Heat the oil in a small pan, crackle the mustard seeds, and add the curry leaves for a few seconds.
Pour the tempering over the poha and mix gently with a fork so the flakes stay separate.
Serve straight away at room temperature.
